Expected Consequence: Checking my inventory will reveal if I am already holding the potato.
Action: inventory

config.score_display: 100*won auxiliary only; not ScienceWorld partial score
config.native_equivalence: Exact public transitions/admissible commands and private fact digest; not full hidden RNG serialization

failed_attempt_receipt_limitations.root_cause: Generated scheduler module omitted dataclasses.asdict import; original episode AST was unchanged but a global binding was missing
failed_attempt_receipt_limitations.fixed: Import asdict, statically verify all referenced globals, test full trace serialization, persist actual state receipts even after STOP
failed_attempt_receipt_limitations.state_receipt_limitations: Worker0 was stopped during native lookahead. Two passive state replies are inferred from the capture-accounting stack; native branch initialization/candidate receipt contents were not persisted. Failed attempt has 10..11 API query attempts and9..11 state replies, not a falsely exact count. Budget reserves the upper bound.
failed_attempt_receipt_limitations.wall_budget: 2h cumulative ACTIVE server-run time; network downtime with all owned models exited is excluded; original415.225s and failed40.738s are charged

limits: Three development games, one rollout seed, no significance/generalization claim
Public admissible commands provided equally to all five policies; not exact paper actor prompt
Shared legacy STRUCTURE includes ScienceWorld word in Action placeholder despite ALF-native guidance; retained/frozen across all policies, a prompt limitation
Native inspect returns cached last state receipt; independent processes/fact replay tested, not full process/RNG serialization
Immediate action/feedback changes are not long-horizon causal utility; no controlled continuation experiment
Always50 vs selective5 maximum calls, not matched-budget comparison
Extra Reviewer computation and feedback information are not separated by a no-feedback Reviewer control
Failed scheduler has bounded native receipt uncertainty; raw failed attempt is not assigned task score
